title: Quantum Computing - How Close to Commercial Value?
excerpt: Quantum Computing - How Close to Commercial Value? : IDTechEx Webinar
content:
Quantum computing has steadily gained priority in the technology and industrial strategies of many of the world's largest economies. With several different technology approaches, known as "qubit modalities", now becoming commercialized, the competition is heating up for which players can first build and demonstrate the acceleration of commercially relevant algorithms with quantum computing.

However, the quantum industry is frequently misunderstood, clouding real progress with hype and miscommunication. This webinar will give an accessible overview of the quantum computing market, discussing how and when quantum computing hardware will generate revenue, while explaining the most impactful trends that have occurred over the last 12 months. IDTechEx will also provide insights into its Quantum Commercial Readiness Level (QCRL) benchmarking scheme and 20-year forecast methodology for the quantum computing market.

• An Introduction to Quantum Technologies

• Quantum Computing Market Introduction: Value proposition and the different technology approaches - qubit modalities.

• The Business Model for Quantum Computing: Quantum as a Service (QaaS) and the "killer applications" of quantum computing

• 2026 Key Market Trends: New entrants and IPOs, quantum computer benchmarking, mergers and acquisitions

• How Close is Quantum Computing to Commercial Value: IDTechEx's QCRL scale and forecast methodology
